description: This source file defines the DefaultBlobContainerFactory class, which implements the IBlobContainerFactory interface. The class provides methods to initialize and retrieve a BlobContainerClient, specifically for working with Azure Blob Storage within the Orleans framework, using options provided during construction.

classes.name: DefaultBlobContainerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing BlobContainerClient instances using Azure Blob Storage, parameterized by storage options.

methods.name: GetBlobContainerClient
methods.description: Returns the BlobContainerClient instance associated with this factory.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the BlobContainerClient by creating the container in Azure Blob Storage if it does not already exist.
